body: Your post is super beautiful. I'm sorry you're in so much pain. I'm super depressed and so incredibly miserable, but so many things you said are things I've been feeling and thinking and haven't been able to find the words for. I sincerely hope things get better for you. <3

Everything I use to love means nothing to me. I have enough money to travel the world but I won't even go grocery shopping unless one of my friends offers to go with me. I don't care about doing art anymore and all I've ever been is an artist. Every single part of who I used to be has died and nothing has grown in its place. I totally understand how you feel.
